## Automated Test Requirements — Verified (2026-08-11)

All tests verified by direct execution. **119 tests, 0 failures.**

| Story | Test File(s) | Count | Result |
|-------|-------------|-------|--------|
| CAM-001 | `tests/unit/camera/isometric_projection_test.go` | 30 | PASS |
| CAM-002 | `tests/unit/camera/zoom_system_test.go` | 15 | PASS |
| CAM-003 | `tests/integration/camera/follow_framing_test.go` | 16 | PASS |
| CAM-004 | `tests/integration/camera/occlusion_boundaries_test.go` | 9 | PASS |
| CAM-004 (bonus) | `tests/unit/camera/occlusion_test.go` | 20 | PASS |
| Sprint 1 regression | `tests/unit/entity/` (30) + `tests/integration/entity/` (15) | 45 | PASS |
| INFRA-001 | `go test marrow-of-empire-tests/...` from root | — | PASS (5/5 pkgs) |

**Running tests correctly**: 
- From repo root: `go test marrow-of-empire-tests/...`
- From `tests/`: `go test ./unit/... ./integration/...`
- ⚠️ `go test ./...` from repo root does NOT work (not a module directory). INFRA-001 AC-2 uses this broken command.
- ⚠️ `cd src && go test ./tests/...` also fails (Go pattern resolution ignores the symlink). Use the module-qualified path instead.

**Performance note**: EF-006 spatial-query gate is load-sensitive. Under concurrent load it can spike to 4.886ms (budget: 1ms). In isolation it passes at 0.318ms. Do not run entity perf tests concurrently with camera suites.

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Game launches to main menu without crash
2. `go test marrow-of-empire-tests/...` passes from repo root (119 tests)
3. Camera renders isometric view — no perspective distortion
4. Zoom transitions smooth (mouse wheel up/down through all levels)
5. Party follow — camera tracks moving entities
6. Combat framing — camera frames all combatants at encounter start
7. Structure occlusion — structures fade when between camera and player
8. Boundary clamp — no void space visible at region edges
9. Save/load round-trip (if client supports it)
